flags.issue: Old 'Type Bambu' has one page and one set of photos; the two units cannot be told apart, so both get the identical set. Only 4 usable photos (2 of the 7 are plant close-ups), no landscape exterior, hero is a bedroom at 1280 px. The best exterior (1152) is portrait 2184x4608.

Old 'Type Puspa' is one page for three units and the photos give no way to tell them apart (no unit numbers, same cottage design), so all three get the identical set. Only 8 usable photos; the sole exterior (95) is 600x400.

Old page has 1 photo. Filled from the unused pool (2020-12 'Cireme' series, 3 photos) plus one 2018 'gl8' file. Nothing is >=1600 px; the best exterior shots (1015, 1016) are 1152 px, so the hero is the 1280x853 deck interior (1018). Still only 5 photos total, no bathroom.

The old site used the same image on several tent pages (for example the tent bathroom 1053/1028 is on Salak, Gede and, titled Pangrango, on a third; 1056 is also titled Cikuray; 1192 is on both Gede and Pangrango; 1011 and 1005 are titled Cikuray but sat on Malabar/Pangrango). Tents look alike, so assignment uses titles, file prefixes (glamping1_/3_/4_, ...cikuray, ...malabar, ...papandayan, ...burangrang) and camera sequence. Inferred ones are marked in the photo note. Owner should check Salak/Gede/Pangrango interiors (1195, 1193, 1192, 1194, 1199, 1200).
Only 3 photos belong to Malabar by title; the rest are borrowed or near-duplicates. 5 gallery photos incl. a dark night shot (562).
All photos max 1024 px; hero is 1024x683 (below the 1200 minimum). 3 gallery photos come from the unused pool by file sequence (IMG_7377a-7384a).
Every photo except the hero (1357) is portrait.

On the old site the featured images' file names are swapped (Kihyang's featured file is named 'illegole', Ilegole's is named 'Kihyang'). The pictures match the right page's gallery, so selection follows the pictures. Kihyang's old gallery was all portrait interiors; 5 landscape photos (981-987) were taken from the unused pool by title 'Kihyang Image 2020-12-11'. Kihyang has no bathroom photo.
No bathroom photo; 4 bedrooms listed but only 2 photographed.

inventory.json pixel sizes are wrong for 42 files (originals are larger than the recorded size, e.g. IMG_9828 is 5472x3648, not 2560x1707; EXIF-rotated files have width/height swapped). The manifest and contact sheet use real pixel sizes read from the files.
Two hi-res photos carry burned-in text: 564 (Cendana exterior, 'Villa type Cendana') and 269 (pool, 'Kolam Renang'). They are not used; both are listed as rejected alternates.
Faces are visible in 450, 438, 1206, 234 and in the group photo 1379 (special-school-package, possibly children). The owner should confirm the right to publish.

family and company-outing have no old page, and special-school-package has one photo. Their galleries borrow clear matches (pool, aula, outbound games, bonfire, grill food) from the old Outbound/Packages pages and the unused pool; hero re-uses the Aula and a pool shot.

tenda-salak: caption says dusk, photo is daytime. malam-gathering: caption mentions a guitar, photo shows a bonfire only. villa-bambu: caption says terrace; there is no Bambu terrace photo, so the hut and path is used. sungai-jernih: 1204 is assumed to be on-site (same shoot as the Aula/tent photos); confirm.

Only curug-cigamea (325) and curug-ngumpet (192) could be matched, by file name only. 192 is portrait 683x1024. The home 'explore' card is labelled Curug Seribu but uses a generic waterfall group shot (1215).
